review.method: Primary verified full UTF8 serialization uses same declared types/options and snapshot-RNG-trace-details order, exact span content equality, no capture/check removed. Request comparison remains unchanged.
review.workerUse: Bounded static field/order and risk inventory, not performance/rule authority. Primary checked 14 detail fields and SnapshotJson implementation. Worker overcounted pure scenarios and described preexisting Chinese text as surrogate-pair coverage; these claims were not adopted.

limitations: Three repetitions of six fixed simulator workloads, not a whole-corpus throughput or authentic rule-parity estimate.
Fresh-process startup included, OS caches and machine load uncontrolled. Worker review overlapped only the beginning of the benchmark.
Timers are temporary diagnostics, not production timings. Uninstrumented runs provide the A/B measurements.
No hashing, cached callback state, skipped field or independent reference reduction in production detector.
Existing unrelated working-tree modifications excluded from both source snapshots.
NNTrain retained the same 10 existing CS8632 warnings.
